newsitem.title: CROATIA: Samsung said to invest $34.5 mln in Croatian port.
newsitem.headline: Samsung said to invest $34.5 mln in Croatian port.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung will invest $34.5 million to modernise Croatian port of Rijeka, through which it plans to funnel its goods into Central Europe, daily Vecernji List reported on Wednesday.
It said the annual capacity of Croatia's main port, which lies in the north Adriatic, would increase to 10 million tonnes of goods from the present three million.
Singapoor port is interested in building a multifunctional terminal in Rijeka. Samsung would invest in six new cranes and a container bridge, the paper said.

The port which staggers under the weight of huge debts, has lost 36 percent of its traffic this year. It badly needs upgrading which could make it competitive with Koper and Triest in neighboring Slovenia and Italy. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
